notes: ?dept=<id> filters the shelves to that boutique and scrolls to them.
&sku=<sku_id> opens that product's detail view directly.
Unknown dept ids fall back to the Agent Deck Pop-Up boutique; unknown sku ids are ignored.
The page updates the URL via history.replaceState as the visitor browses (no reloads).

name: Ultimate Market
rules: No pricing is ever displayed in the district. Copy sells on value and proof.
The market never files equip issues itself. Equips are user/agent actions.
No fake equips, no fake activity, no placeholder visuals.
CWI logo appears on every storefront and product card.

coordinates_hint.note: Placed by the scene worker. Suggested: central plaza of the world map, on the main promenade — the market is the commercial heart, so it should sit where foot traffic is highest.

scene_integration.entry: market/index.html renders standalone; the scene may embed it via deep link or iframe it at any size (responsive down to 360px).

tagline: The commercial heart of Project Ultimate
